title: Dose-response meta-analysis in the browser: validation of the allmeta dose-response app against R dosresmeta
description: Frozen copy of the allmeta dose-response meta-analysis app (two-stage Greenland-Longnecker method; linear trend and restricted cubic splines, REML pooling) and a one-command validation of its shipped engine against the R package dosresmeta on every multi-study binary dataset bundled with dosresmeta. Includes the corpus builder, R reference fits, the engine runner, the analysis that regenerates the article's tables, figures and statistics with a PASS/FAIL check of every number, a Docker image (canonical environment: R 4.6.0, dosresmeta 2.2.0, Node 24.15.0) and CI on Linux, Windows, macOS and Docker. The validation documents both agreement (3-knot splines) and defects of the shipped app (linear trend with non-zero reference doses; 4-knot splines; no refusal of unidentifiable spline fits).
